facts.business: Pashupati Cotspin Limited is engaged in cotton spinning and textile manufacturing, operating a plant at Kadi, Gujarat, and is eligible for state subsidies under the Gujarat Textile Policy.

capacity_or_capex.item: Solar Term Loan and Machinery (Cosmos Co-operative Bank)
Property Mortgage Term Loan (Cosmos Co-operative Bank)
Term Loan – Machinery Finance (Shree Kadi Nagarik Sahakari Bank)

key_risks: Dependence on state subsidy receivable under Gujarat Textile Policy subject to government amendments and disbursement modalities
High debt exposure with multiple term loans and cash credit facilities from various banks
Concentration of operations at a single plant location in Kadi, Gujarat
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions proposed with R.V. Enterprise for FY 2026-27, subject to shareholder approval.
